name: Kalyani Cast-Tech Ltd
tagline: Debt-free micro-cap castings/container maker on two national policy tailwinds, but FY26 revenue growth stalled to +8%, wagon plant slipped to H2FY27, and the stock now trades at ~41x P/E
business_overview: Kalyani Cast-Tech manufactures castings and is aggressively diversifying into specialized ISO/rail containers (now 5 distinct products) and, prospectively, freight wagons — positioned directly against India's new container-manufacturing push (CMAS scheme) and Indian Railways' liberalized wagon design policy.
fundamentals_table: ~Rs 739 Cr (P/E ~41, P/B ~9x; up from ~Rs 560 Cr last pass)
Rs 63 Cr (FY23) -> Rs 94 Cr (FY24) -> Rs 139 Cr (FY25) -> Rs 150 Cr (FY26, only +8% YoY)
Rs 23 Cr / 15% FY26 (H1FY26 margin down ~200bps on new-capacity underutilisation)
FY26 CFO ~Rs 19 Cr, FCF ~Rs 3 Cr (investing -Rs 23 Cr)
Virtually debt-free (borrowings ~Rs 1 Cr, Mar 2026); 0% promoter pledge
Rs 438.65 - ~Rs 1,050+ (broken well above prior Rs 815 high)
fundamentals_narrative: Quality metrics remain strong for a micro-cap — 31% ROCE, 24% ROE, effectively debt-free, 0% promoter pledge, promoter group ~68% (MD ~27.5% direct). But the headline growth story cooled in FY26: revenue rose just ~8% (Rs 139 Cr -> Rs 150 Cr) after two years of ~48-49% growth, EBITDA Rs 23 Cr at a 15% margin with H1FY26 margins down ~200bps as new capacity ramps under-utilised. FY26 PAT Rs 18 Cr (EPS Rs 24.87), CFO ~Rs 19 Cr but FCF only ~Rs 3 Cr as the Rs 170-200 Cr Phase-1 capex (part of a Rs 450-500 Cr long-term plan) absorbs cash. Capex is being funded from IPO proceeds, internal accruals and convertible warrants (Rs 18.8 Cr at Rs 582 in June 2026, plus a further preferential warrant issue approved at a 28-Jul-2026 EGM) — 'over 80% of machine advances' reportedly deployed without adding debt. The stock has since re-rated hard to ~41x P/E / ~9x P/B, pricing in a wagon/container ramp that has been pushed out.
sentiment_summary: Read most recent 50 of 240 posts (single batch, no escalation, covers June-Aug 2026). A genuinely active thread with a steady stream of concrete operational milestones (first container rake movement, new manufacturing facility in Kachchh, Gati Shakti terminal trial train) alongside real skepticism about promotional practices.
community_signal: Trusted-roster user hnk_so posted twice but with a skeptical/neutral tone (questioning the 'data center' narrative's technical substance), not a conviction call — no high-conviction entry logged. Most engaged poster: Serendip (25 loves/10 posts), tracking policy and operational news closely. A real, unresolved debate emerged: Pranav_Lakhotia (7 loves, self-described as invested but 'not as biased as most') directly challenged the company's heavy reliance on the promoter's personal X/Twitter account for updates instead of formal concalls/disclosures, suspecting 'narrative pushing' and paid social-media promotion; Familyman and others pushed back that the company has otherwise been transparent. hnk_so separately noted a broader SME-small-cap pattern of overusing 'data center' as a buzzword with little technical substance.
bse_notes: Company has now started holding earnings calls (Q2 FY26 call held). Rs 18.8 Cr raised via convertible warrants at Rs 582 (June 2026); a further preferential convertible warrant issue approved at an EGM on 28-Jul-2026. Order book ~Rs 140 Cr with ~Rs 92.6 Cr executed by 30-Sep; 23 new clients added (incl. Coach Builders, Western Carriers). First container trial train reached the Gati Shakti terminal at Kachchh (Aug 2026); 20ft stainless-steel salt container trial at Bhimasar successful; RDSO in-principle approval for a specialised container-transport wagon design. Still SME-board listed.
bull_case: Two concrete national policy catalysts intact: India's container-manufacturing push (CMAS, 7.5 lakh containers/yr target vs ~30,000 today) and Indian Railways' liberalised wagon-design policy plus a ~Rs 40,000 Cr / 100,000-unit wagon tender over 3-4 years
Debt-free, 31% ROCE / 24% ROE, 0% promoter pledge, promoter group ~68% — genuinely clean balance sheet and skin in the game

Real, verifiable operational progress continues: first container trial train to the Kachchh Gati Shakti terminal, successful stainless-steel salt-container trial, RDSO in-principle nod for a specialised container-transport wagon, 23 new clients, ~Rs 140 Cr order book
144-acre integrated wagon facility (7,500-8,000 wagons/yr target) and container capacity expansion from ~6,000 to ~16,000 TEU give a large step-up in revenue potential once commissioned
Capex so far funded without debt (IPO proceeds + accruals + warrants)
bear_case: FY26 revenue grew only ~8% (Rs 139 Cr -> Rs 150 Cr) after +48-49% in FY24 and FY25 — the 'doubling every two years' momentum stalled and the next leg depends entirely on capacity that isn't live yet
Wagon-manufacturing facility timeline pushed again — now 'second half of FY27' — citing government-approval delays; repeated slippage against a thesis that is priced for execution
Stock has re-rated to ~41x P/E / ~9x P/B (market cap ~Rs 739 Cr vs ~Rs 560 Cr last pass) — the wagon/container ramp is already in the price, leaving little margin for further delay
H1FY26 EBITDA margin fell ~200bps on new-capacity underutilisation; FY26 FCF only ~Rs 3 Cr as capex absorbs operating cash
Two rounds of convertible-warrant dilution (June 2026 + 28-Jul-2026 EGM); still SME-board listed with lighter disclosure

Historic IR-transparency concern (promoter's personal X account as primary update channel) only partly addressed — earnings calls have now started, but formal disclosure cadence is still thin; a community skeptic flagged 'data center' line as buzzword-chasing
verdict_headline: Still an asymmetric policy-driven setup, but FY26 growth stalled, the wagon plant slipped to H2FY27, and a ~41x P/E now prices in a ramp yet to be delivered — trim conviction to Medium-High
verdict_reasoning: The core thesis (debt-free micro-cap, 31% ROCE, two dated government catalysts, real operational milestones, 0% pledge) is intact and remains the kind of asymmetric bet this screen targets

But this pass materially changes the risk/reward: FY26 revenue rose just ~8%, H1 margins compressed, wagon commissioning is now H2FY27 after repeated delays, and the stock has re-rated to ~41x P/E / ~9x P/B — execution is now required simply to justify the current price, not to generate upside
Two rounds of warrant dilution and continued SME-board status add mild governance/technical caution; IR has improved (earnings calls started) but is not yet robust

Net: conviction moves High -> Medium-High. Thesis-fit stays 10x-in-2-3-years because the capacity step-up and policy tailwinds are real and dated, but the entry is no longer cheap and the next 2-3 quarters need to show the wagon/container ramp actually converting to revenue

deep_dive.conviction_update: High -> Medium-High. Filings confirm the balance sheet and returns are clean and the operational milestones are real, but FY26 revenue growth collapsed to ~8%, the wagon plant slipped to H2FY27 for a second time, dilution is ongoing, and the stock now trades at ~41x P/E — execution is now needed just to hold the valuation, so the asymmetry has narrowed.

four_box.note: Two dated govt catalysts (wagon/container) = real structural tailwind+headroom for a debt-free micro-cap; no moat data; re-rated to 41x P/E/9x P/B, verdict says 'execution now required simply to justify price, not generate upside'

Revenue growth -15% FY21, +346% FY22 (tiny base), +29% FY23, +49% FY24, +40% FY25, +8% FY26. Both cleared FY22-FY25 = 4 of 6; FY21 missed on the contraction, FY26 on the +8% slowdown.

quality_metrics.note: roce_pct is TTM/FY26 ~29% (FY25 31%, FY24 30%). Debt-free (borrowings Rs 1cr, D/E 0.01) so ND/EBITDA ~0 and interest expense ~nil (coverage null). FCF-conv ~-2%: trailing 3y (CFO-capex) roughly nil vs EBITDA ~Rs 57cr as Rs 18-23cr/yr capex absorbs operating cash during the castings/ISO-container capacity build. OPM 14-18% band, stable. High ROCE + debt-free + 5x revenue FY22-FY25 -> positive, with thin FCF and an FY26 growth slowdown as caveats.
